verdict.rationale: Agora's docs say it ships its own CLI, MCP server and Skills so a coding agent can work with Agora. That implies a user could drive Agora through natural-language prompts to an AI agent, but this rests on a single thin mention with no detail on what the MCP server can do (docs lookup versus actual operations). The voice-agent and LLM features are capabilities for building end-user apps, not for operating Agora itself, so they are not credited. missing for 10: documentation of which product operations the MCP server/Skills expose, examples of natural-language commands acting on projects, channels or tokens, any built-in natural-language console interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Let your coding agent build with Agora. Connect the CLI, MCP server, and Skills to your AI workflow.
